reactions.description: The P450 monooxygenase SlnF performs the hydroxylation at C-20 in cognate with ferredoxin SlnE

The final steps of salinomycin assembly involve C-20 hydroxylation by SlnE/SlnF followed by polyether chain release from the PKS by thioesterases SlnDI/SlnDII. Lastly, the methyltransferase-like enzyme SlnM catalyzes the spirocyclization-coupled dehydration of OH-19 and forms the final product salinomycin.

evidenceCode: Inference from genomic data and chemical structure
